gloss: to calculate; to compute; to push out

definitions.explanation: To work out a number or result, especially using a calculator or abacus.

definitions.gloss: to push out; to force out
definitions.explanation: To expel or exclude someone or something.

examples.japanese: コンピューターで{答|こた}えを{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To calculate the answer with a computer.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}したら、{思|おも}ったより{高|たか}かった。
examples.english: When I calculated the budget, it was higher than I thought.

examples.japanese: {競争|きょうそう}で{負|ま}けた{会社|かいしゃ}は{市場|しじょう}から{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}される。
examples.english: Companies that lose the competition are pushed out of the market.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す → {弾|はじ}き{出|だ}さない (negative)
・{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す → {弾|はじ}き{出|だ}して (te-form)
・{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す → {弾|はじ}き{出|だ}した (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {弾|はじ}く (to flick, to calculate) + {出|だ}す (to put out)

ETYMOLOGY:
The calculating sense comes from using an abacus ({算盤|そろばん}), where beads are "flicked" to produce results.

USAGE:
・{数字|すうじ}を{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す (to work out figures)
・{見積|みつも}りを{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す (to calculate an estimate)
・{仲間|なかま}から{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}される (to be excluded from a group)
